notes.title: Current Status and Future of Frontier Mode
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Project MIKHAIL".
Since release, we have not been able to operate as an online game at the level our customers expect, and we apologize for the trouble this has caused our players.
Frontier Mode was intended to be a mode where players all join forces and reach the ending together. However, the current game lacks the necessary information to clear it, causing a burden on many players.
Many of the factors contributing to this burden lie in the Potentiality failure (defeat) conditions. Although we have made some adjustments in a recent update to alleviate the issue, the fundamental problem has not been resolved. Thus we are currently considering relaxing the conditions even further.
The development team is currently redeveloping Frontier Mode as a simple, single-player game mode, based off the existing Frontier Mode system, without multiplayer or the need to restart from the beginning.
Details about the specific update date and content will be announced on the official website and livestreams in the near future.
We look forward to your continued support of Project MIKHAIL.

[b][h1][Changes][/h1][/b]

[b]◆Target lock mode can now be turned off (Free movement)[/b]
[list]
[*] Turning [OFF] the target lock mode enables aiming. You can point the camera in the direction of the target or fire in the direction that you wish.
[*] *Target lock mode [ON] is the same behavior as before.
[*] Switching the target lock mode from [OFF] to [ON] will target the enemy closest to the targeting reticle.
[*] *By default, target locking can be turned [ON]/[OFF] using the “Y” key on the keyboard, the “scroll wheel button” on the mouse, and “R3” on the gamepad.
[*] By default, target lock mode switching is toggled every time you press the button/key it, but you can turn [ON] (or  [OFF] target lock only while holding down the button/key by setting “Settings” > “Control Settings”> “Lock Mode only active when input active” to [ON]
[*] Target lock mode is set to [ON] at the start of the battle by default. You can change this setting by going to “Settings” > “Control Settings”>” Target Lock on Battle Start”.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124079/d1c10a9b3116a9dd32fc1d508ece09cfa22f07f8.gif[/img]

[b]◆Implemented Low Speed movement.[/b]
[list]
[*] Low speed movement allows you to move while preserving your vernier gauge. You can also shoot while moving at low speed.
[*] By default, low speed movement can be done holding  “Shift” on the keyboard or “B button” on the gamepad (or “R1” for B-type).
[*] You can change the behavior to “Low Speed move with movement input, boost with input/Low Speed + movement input” by setting “Settings” > “Control Settings”>”Low Speed when Boost / Low Speed input active” to [OFF].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124079/e701e2c87d136f33cda22a80b8750eee14e32d7b.gif[/img]

[b]◆Changed the default battle control settings for gamepads.[/b]
[list]
[*] Target filter = Menu button (For both A/B type).
[*] Switch Target Filter (Back) = X button + left stick up (A type) / left trigger + right stick up (B type).
[*] Switch Target Filter (Next) = X button + left stick down (A type) / left trigger + right stick down (B type).
[*] Switch Target Filter (Nearest) = X button + left stick button (A type) / left trigger + right stick button (B type).
[*] Style switch (Next) = Left trigger + Left bumper (B type only).
[/list]

[b]◆Default assignments for mouse buttons for “Battle Keybindings”.[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon switching is now assigned to mouse wheel up/down.
[*] Attack (Main Weapon 2) and Attack (Sub Weapon 2) have been changed from Shift+Right/Left Click to Alt+Right/Left Click to avoid conflicting with low-speed movement.
[*] “Settings” > “Control Settings”>”Attack with left and right mouse clicks” has been removed.
[/list]

[b]◆“Settings” > “Control Settings”>”High-speed target change when target destroyed” has been implemented.[/b]

[b]◆Resolution and Full Screen in Settings > Basic Settings are merged into Window Size, and Full Screen can be selected from the pull-down menu.[/b]

[b]◆Support for Steam Controller.[/b]
[list]
[*] If you are using a DirectInput controller and are experiencing problems, please turn on the controller support function to solve the problem.
[/list]

[b]◆Onscreen guides will now show buttons for non-Xbox controllers.
[/b]
[list]
[*] You can change the symbols that display by enabling support for various settings in the controller settings in Steam. Unsupported controllers will continue to be shown with Xbox icons.
[/list]

[b]◆Adjusted action cancellation by jump/dive to be more powerful and usable.
[/b]
[b]◆Implemented filter settings for the mass selection function on the sell and dismantle screens.
[/b][list]
[*] You can now specify rarity, level, generation, doctrine, and type of armament from the button next to “Select Multiple”.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41124079/439dd4115aa5709ef7a730fd7b340e9a373aa54e.jpg[/img]

[b]◆A warning message will now display when “Epic” or “Legendary” parts and weapons are included for sale or dismantling.[/b]
[b]◆The sort function now uses a list.[/b]

[b]◆Story Mode: Added “Low Speed Movement” and “Target Lock Mode” to the battle tutorial.[/b]
*We will add more content to the “Play Guide” at a later date.
[b]◆Story Mode: Implemented simulators that allow you to battle specific BETAs.[/b]
[list]
[*] From the start, you can battle [Grappler], [Destroyer], and [Tank] classes, 
As the story progresses [Fort], [Laser], and [Heavy Laser] classes will also be added.
[/list]
[b]◆Frontier Mode: Set mission grace time for key missions except “Operation Cherry Blossom”.[/b]
*This does not apply to missions that are already in progress.

[b]◆[Bug Fix][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the camera would stay low when targeting small BETA, making it difficult to see the BETA.

[*] Fixed an issue that would occur when approaching a target while firing. When you moved past your target, you would now be firing in the wrong direction. This will no longer occur.

[*] Fixed an issue where the effect value of a property would sometimes exceed the maximum value.

[*] Fixed a bug in which the model number of the Gekishin was listed as “Type-94” instead of “Type-77” in the item details screen.

[*] Story Mode: Fixed an issue where the game would force-quit in rare cases during Prologue III.

[*] Story Mode: Fixed an issue where the main screen background would disappear when a mission looped.

[*] Frontier Mode: Fixed an issue where some missions did not finish even though all BETA were destroyed.

[*] Frontier Mode: Fixed an issue where a “server connection error” would occur when going to the home screen.


[*] PVP Mode: Fixed an issue where the camera would only show the target when the skill “Mad Butterfly” failed to reach the target.

[*] PVP Mode: Fixed an issue where using a skill in midair would sometimes trigger a different skill.

[*] PVP Mode: Fixed a bug that prevented players from performing combos when using the secondary weapon slash in midair with the “Dual Blade Style”.

[*] PVP Mode: Competitive Mode: Fixed an issue where Step Shooting would cause the character to step twice.
[/list]

notes.title: Update on Issue With the Latest Patch
notes.content:
Here is our update on the issue with the latest patch, as well as our response.

[Nature of the Current Issue]
In some cases, parts will be manufactured at a lower level than the displayed level. When this happened, the parts were costing the minimum amount of materials required to produce equipment of the displayed level, not the lower one.

[Cause of the Issue]
The level of manufactured parts is determined by a variable that's equal to the highest level parts you've obtained in the past. However, there is also a cap based on your mission level limit. This cap was only being applied AFTER the part was created, meaning that you were being charged the full, pre-lowering cost of the part.

[How We're Fixing This]
We'll be setting the variable that determines the level of parts you can make equal to the current mission level limit.
*This will not affect any equipment you currently own.
*You can raise the limit by clearing Hive Recon Missions.

[Compensation]
We'll be refunding users the difference between the pre-lowered part cost and the post-lowered part cost.

[Who Is Affected]
Users who manufactured parts above the level limit between our 20:40 emergency maintenance and our 21:30 second emergency maintenance.

We apologize for the inconvenience. It will take us a little time to see which users were affected by this issue, so we'll be providing more updates later.

notes.title: 12/8 Maintenance complete and Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The maintenance is now concluded.

In case you missed it, we posted a Producer Letter yesterday:

[previewyoutube=N1Wj3x8kX_E;full][/previewyoutube]

For those who can’t watch the video, here’s a summarized transcript of the Producer Letter:

This is our first Producer Letter since releasing the game.
We'd like to thank you all for buying, and for playing, Project Mikhail. Thank you so much!
We're so grateful for the feedback! We've gone through every one of them, and we're currently spending a lot of time figuring out how to make the best use of it.

We hope you'll keep supporting us.
The most common feedback were about the controls, movement, and camera, so we'll be changing them heavily.
The developers are still figuring out how exactly we'll be changing them, but the changes will be big.
The big changes are going to take more time, but we've done some things we think will make the game better for the time being.
We fixed a lot of bugs we've found since launch, but we also incorporated some of your feedback to fix the game.

[b]Here are the changes:[/b]
[olist]
[*][b]Removal of Z-aN login requirement[/b] - When you play the game for the first time, we required you create a Z-aN account to login. We've now made this optional! You can now play through Story mode or Frontier mode with ease.
However for the versus mode, we use Z-aN for the matching system. So that's still required for now. But please don't worry! We'll be getting rid of it in the future as well.
[*][b]Movement[/b] - You can now move in eight directions, and we've added an option to to stop moving upon letting go of the button.
Until now, if you're boosting, you'd keep going even after letting go of the button. Many of you found this hard to use, so turn it on, and you'll stop using boost movement when you let go of the button.
[*][b]Guns[/b] - We've now made it so bullet damage drops less with distance.
Before, you could hold down the fire button and sometimes your guns would stop firing, or the damage dropped off too much with distance, so damaging BETA far away was really hard.
Some of you may have avoided Assault Cannons for that reason. But now Assault Cannons will be much easier to use, so feel free to try them out once more!
[*][b]Blood[/b] - We also added an on/off option to toggle the bloody visuals on TSFs.
There was so much blood on your TSFs that it looked red and sticky, and we had a ton of feedback with players saying they wanted to see the TSF they'd spent so much time making.
We made this toggle so you can make it so you get a better look at your TSF during battles. We hope this makes it easier to enjoy painting your TSF, too!
[*][b]Removed freezing frames when fighting small BETA[/b] - Until now, when you were fighting smaller BETA like Laser and Tank Class, there was a slight freeze frame that makes it look liked time stopped momentarily.
It made the game seem like it was dropping frames, so we've gotten rid of this and this should make the game flow much smoother now.
[*][b]Added more video tutorials[/b] - There's a tutorial at the beginning but it seems many players may find it insufficient to understand the game. So we'll be adding in-game guides with videos to show you what you can do and how.
[/olist]
We thank all our players for the patience waiting for the fixes. We sincerely hope you’ll enjoy the game much more now after the changes. Again, if you have any feedback about this update, please use our form below:
[url=https://forms.gle/B2MH6hYRP7K3XQ9s8]https://forms.gle/B2MH6hYRP7K3XQ9s8[/url]

Thank you for your cooperation, and please look forward to more updates!

notes.title: [Regarding Save Data Loss]
notes.content:
We've received messages from some of you indicating that you've lost save data. Below is our response to the situation and how we intend to handle it.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
◆ Confirmed Issues
・ Save Data loss in Story Mode
・Those with lost save data can’t save in Story Mode.

◆ Cause of the Issues
・ An error during the saving process, such as a device/OS/application crash, etc.

◆ What we're doing to solve the problem
① At 17:10 (JST) 11/8 (Monday) we released a new version of the software.
　 (If you're manually updating, please update from within the steam app.) We’ve done everything we currently can to ensure that, in the event of save data loss after update, you’ll be able to restart from your previous saved data.
② At the same time, we also ensured that those of you who lost save data will be able to save in Story Mode.
　 *Note that we restored the ABILITY to save, which is different than the save data itself.
③ On Tuesday 11/9 (Exact time TBD) we will be adjusting the timing of the save function.
　 The design currently in place saves the game at short intervals in order to ensure that, in the event of a crash, you won’t lose any dropped items. However, in order to prioritize the safety of your data in the event of a crash during saving, we’re setting the game to no longer save item drops during battle.
④ We will also be taking stronger measures in the coming days.

◆ For those of you who have lost data:
・We will restore the most recent data we have for any players whose data we can recover.
・In the event we cannot recover your data, we will work with you individually.

If you've lost data, please do the following:
・Boot Project MIKHAIL,
・enter any mode
・from the Info tab,
・go to Support and contact us.

◆Note
The above error is strictly for Story Mode and has no effect on Frontier/PvP Modes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We are incredibly sorry for this problem, and to those of you who have lost data.

notes.title: [How We're Handling the Frontier Mode Error]
notes.content:
This announcement concerns how we’re going to be handling the problem that occurred with Frontier Mode at 5:00 AM 11/3 today.

***

[Affected Areas]
・Frontier Mode

[Issues]
・Cannot enter battles.
・Game freezes.

[Background... About Frontier Mode]
・Frontier Mode contains 2 different sub-modes, one called FRONTIER, where players inhabit a Potentiality, and one called CHRONICLE.
・Potentialities are worlds shared by all players, where the scenario advances in real-time.
　In a Potentiality, all players work together towards a specific ending, and after the ending, a new Potentiality is created.
・CHRONICLE is a player's personal world, where missions that they have cleared can be replayed.
・Some elements are shared between CHRONICLE and FRONTIER, and some aren’t.
　
　
　◆Elements shared between all FRONTIER Potentialities as well as CHRONICLE mode
　　 ・Skills
　　 ・Proficiency
　◆Elements specific to a single Potentiality (These are reset when a Potentiality ends.)
　　 ・Map and Mission Status (Time Progression, BETA Dominance, etc.)
　　 ・Max Mission Level
　　 ・Items (Parts, weapons, materials, turn-in items, credits, etc.)
　　 ・Reputation
　*As an exception to this rule, there is an item transfer function.
　　Item transfer allows you to send parts and weapons from CHRONICLE to a potentiality, or vice-versa.
　　 
　　The item transfer function is not yet implemented, and there’s a limit to how many times you can use it.
[Details of Today’s Error]
・The Potentiality players were using from between launch (3:00 PM at 11/2) to when the error occurred (5:00 AM at 11/3) was improperly declared to be completed, and a serious error occurred.
　Recovering its data is extremely difficult. As a result, [◆ all player data tied specifically to that Potentiality] will be reset.
　
　We are extremely sorry to everyone who’s been playing and enjoying the mode since launch.
・[◆ Data shared across all parts of Frontier Mode] has not been lost, so your character progression is safe.
[How We’ll Stop This From Happening in the Future]
・The cause of this problem was that some Potentiality data was set up to be automatically deleted after that Potentiality came to its end.
・We'll be going over our auto-deletion rules to keep this from happening again.
[Our Apology]
Again, we are extremely sorry to all of you who lost all the things you worked so hard to gain.
We know this isn’t anything compared to the time you invested, but this is what we’ll be offering to players as an apology.
The following parts, usable in Frontier Mode’s Potentiality, will be handed out to users.
*These parts will be lost on the closure of the next Potentiality, but we’ll be implementing the item transfer function by the time it closes.
　 You can send them to CHRONICLE if you want to keep them.

 (Items Distributed)

 A Set of Gekishin Parts (6 Parts) (Epic Rarity, Level 30)
 A Set of Phantom Parts (6 Parts) (Epic Rarity, Level 30)
 A Type 74 Blade (Legendary Rarity, Level 30)
 A Type 87 Assault Cannon[APCBCHE] (Legendary Rarity, Level 30)
 *Part properties are determined randomly upon receipt.

 (Who Will Be Receiving Them)

 ・All players who play Project MIKHAIL up until the closure of the next Potentiality, which will begin today.
 *When a Potentiality closes is up to the actions of the players, so it’s hard to say when exactly it will happen.
　 But we think it should be at least the middle of November.

 (Distribution Time)

・7:00 PM JST 11/3
*Items will be distributed to players after login.

 (How to Receive)

・Please receive from the Supply Drop on your Frontier Mode screen.
[Regarding Emergency Maintenance and the Next Potentiality]
・Maintenance is scheduled to end at 3:00 PM 11/3 (JST)
・A new Potentiality will begin as soon as maintenance is ended.
・PvP will be enabled at the same time.

***

Again, we’re extremely sorry for these issues.
We’ll be working to improve not just the game, but how we handle these issues in the future.
Thank you again for helping us with our early access!
